name: @workerv2/image-backend
description: Worker V2 Native Image Backend — the replaceable, framework-independent pixel-processing backend future image processors use for DETERMINISTIC image transformations. Backend contracts (decode/resize/rotate/crop/ICC-convert/validate) + a Pixel Gateway that produces immutable, content-addressed raster Artifacts + a deterministic pure-TypeScript reference backend + a reusable backend contract-test harness. A native/GPU backend (sharp/libvips) is a reserved drop-in behind the SAME contracts. Implements NO album knowledge, NO page rendering, NO PDF, NO product logic, and depends on NO coordinator.
